item.title: Jewish security organization working to keep its community safe amid elevated terror threat
item.summary: Jewish security organizations, like Magen Am, are working to train volunteers on how to respond to an attack as the potential threat rises amid the conflict in the Middle East.

item.title: Trump gives Iran 48-hour ultimatum to reopen Strait of Hormuz or face strikes on power plants
item.summary: Trump warns Iran it has 48 hours to fully reopen the Strait of Hormuz or the U.S. will strike and obliterate its power plants, starting with the largest.

item.title: Man found not guilty by reason of insanity in killing of pregnant Seattle woman, unborn child
item.summary: Cordell Goosby was found not guilty by reason of insanity in the 2023 shooting death of pregnant Seattle woman Eina Kwon, which subsequently killed her unborn child.

item.title: Venezuelan migrant arrested after Loyola Chicago student fatally shot near campus
item.summary: Authorities arrest a Venezuelan migrant following the shooting death of Loyola University Chicago student Sheridan Gorman, who was killed near campus.

item.title: Floor collapse at New Hampshire wedding venue leaves 6 injured, investigation underway
item.summary: A floor allegedly collapsed at a wedding venue in Tamworth, New Hampshire, injuring at least six people as fire departments and state officials respond.

item.title: Colorado River management plans to be determined by government after negotiations stall
item.summary: The federal government is moving forward with plans on how to manage the Colorado River after negotiations on access stalled between seven Western states and 30 tribal nations.

item.title: MLB umpire caught on hot mic begging pitch to 'please be a strike' after catcher issues ABS challenge
item.summary: MLB's Automated Ball-Strike System had a memorable spring training moment when umpire Bill Miller's open mic caught him saying, "Please be a strike" during a challenge.

item.title: Family reunited with their lost cat 5 years later when she was found in stranger's basement
item.summary: A Maryland family's cat, Artemis, was reunited with her owners after five years missing when the Humane Society of Harford County scanned her microchip.

item.title: Pence: Trump upended ‘some aspects’ of GOP agenda but ‘hasn't really changed the Republican Party’
item.summary: Mike Pence says preserving conservative principles amid rising GOP populism is the calling of his life, ahead of his new book on the conservative agenda.

item.title: No 12 High Point falls short of Sweet Sixteen bid after late run by four-seed Arkansas
item.summary: High Point showed resilience and firepower in March Madness, but Arkansas pulled away late to end the Panthers’ historic tournament run.
